scene: In a quiet dressing corner, Dad kneels screen-left and Child stands screen-right beside a low bench. Exactly two choice shirts lie on the bench: one red shirt with white stripes at bench-left and one red shirt with a single dinosaur graphic at bench-right. Both patterns are visible from the first frame and stay on their original red shirts; never add a third choice shirt. Child is the four-year-old tiger boy. His yellow T-shirt stays on throughout; he receives the dinosaur shirt and prepares to get dressed after the clip, with no wardrobe jump. The locked 16:9 medium two-shot includes both faces, hands and both choice shirts.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Dad and Child are attentive and relaxed, with normal family conversation volume and restrained faces and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child briefly considers the visible patterns, then shows mild pleasure with a small smile and nod when naming them. Dad's clarification stays patient and matter-of-fact.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, bouncing, cheering, forceful pointing or raised voices. Do not stretch faces or bodies or turn Child's confirmation into a shout.

clips.start: Dad kneels screen-left with empty hands; Child stands screen-right wearing his yellow T-shirt; the red striped shirt lies at bench-left and the red dinosaur shirt at bench-right.
clips.action: Dad invites getting dressed with a small open-hand gesture over both red shirts. Child looks from one shirt to the other and asks for the dinosaur one by name, without pointing or reaching yet.
clips.end: Dad and Child remain beside the bench with empty hands; the red striped shirt stays at bench-left and the red dinosaur shirt at bench-right; Child still wears his yellow T-shirt.

clips.start: Dad and Child remain beside the bench with empty hands; the red striped shirt stays at bench-left and the red dinosaur shirt at bench-right; Child still wears his yellow T-shirt.
clips.action: Dad turns both shirts slightly toward Child during his question about the shared color. Child points once, briefly, at the dinosaur shirt and names both patterns — the big dinosaur and the stripes — then rests his hand at his side.
clips.end: Dad lifts the red dinosaur shirt from bench-right with both hands, graphic facing Child; the red striped shirt rests untouched at bench-left; Child has empty hands.

clips.start: Dad holds the red dinosaur shirt with both hands just above bench-right, graphic facing Child; the red striped shirt rests at bench-left; Child has empty hands.
clips.action: Dad hands the dinosaur shirt to Child, who receives it with both hands below his face and thanks Dad with a small pleased smile. He says he will wear it right away while holding it ready against his chest. His yellow T-shirt stays on; changing happens after this clip.
clips.end: Child holds the red dinosaur shirt with both hands below his face, in front of his unchanged yellow T-shirt; the red striped shirt rests at bench-left; Dad has empty hands and both remain beside the bench.
